label: TASK-100 Ops place merge - one-row-per-worktree table, 140-worktree smoke
notes: Compare against docs/perf/runs/2026-09-01-task-96-ia-v2-workspace-smoke.json (same headless workspace_perf_smoke.rs harness, 200 frames, 143 worktrees, captured at 55361a0 just before this task started): frame p50 25.523ms p95 27.01ms max 146.228ms, workspace p50 23.816ms p95 24.945ms max 89.548ms. This run: frame p50 5.772ms p95 6.497ms max 81.706ms, workspace p50 4.966ms p95 5.446ms max 33.446ms -- roughly 4-5x faster at p50/p95. Two causes: (1) the merged table is genuinely virtualized (egui_extras::TableBuilder::body::rows only invokes its row closure for rows inside the viewport's clip rect), so counts_max.rows=25 here vs the old swimlane view's counts_max.rows=143/expanded_rows=134 (it rendered nearly every row's full content every frame regardless of scroll position); (2) a flat one-line-per-worktree row is simply less layout work than a CollapsingHeader body with two indented strips. No regression anywhere in the metrics.
